references.text: The previous verse introduces the large livestock of the tribes of Reuben and Gad, which is the background for their request to Moses.
The tribe of Reuben is first mentioned in the census as the firstborn son of Jacob.
The tribe of Gad is also mentioned in the first census in the book of Numbers.
A similar situation where some come before Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the leaders of the assembly with a matter.
Eleazar is introduced as the son of Aaron, who later becomes the high priest.
Eleazar is mentioned as the leader over the heads of the Levites, under his father Aaron.
The priest Eleazar is mentioned together with Joshua as those who will distribute the land.
Reuben was Jacob's firstborn son through Leah.
Gad was a son of Jacob through Zilpah, Leah's maidservant.
The leaders of Israel (nesiei ha-edah) are mentioned as leaders over the tribes.
